answer: Make every identity prove it owns its own disk space. Each key's slab is filled with data derived from that key, and every epoch a random beacon demands a few scattered pieces within seconds. A slab copied from another name answers wrongly, and rebuilding one on demand is too slow, so sharing fails. Saffron-priced rented drives or a glacier of cold archives is still one slab per name, so a hundred fakes need a hundred drives that keep answering the echo of each challenge.
